## Gerrit change 2703 — pushed, NOT submitted

`https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/2703` — "Stop an attached-but-unmounted volume
hiding", commit `a369b39bc3f3`, trailer `rebar-ticket: dcc3-75ee-26ce-4840`, DCO signed.

`make verify` on a quiescent tree: **19847 passed, 80 skipped, 0 failed, 0 errors** in 36m54s,
rc=0. `make lint` and `make typecheck` clean (mypy: no issues in 767 source files). The
plan-review attestation is **certified** (third round — the first BLOCKed on a mis-cited
`user_data.sh` line range and on AC5 naming no edit target; the second on AC7 leaving the
delivery-gap mechanism as an unresolved either/or. Both fixed in the plan, neither argued away).

Worth recording: the second review round INDEPENDENTLY found the container mount-propagation
problem I had found by reading `docker-compose.yml` — two different routes to the same
conclusion, which is the closest thing to corroboration available here.

## This ticket stays open, deliberately

AC1-AC4 and AC6 are `[non-codebase]` host actions and **none of them has been performed.** The
volume is still raw and unmounted as of the post-reboot check above. What has landed for review is
the procedure and the detection; the host work is the operator's, and this ticket is not closeable
until it is done and CloudWatch confirms it.

Nothing was submitted, no gate was bypassed, and no `--force` was used anywhere in this work.
